note: Four things move numbers, and all four are narrow. A weighed pad mass on a design with a pod set or a parallel stage counted a mount's cluster once where the kernel flies it once per copy, so the missing weight was called hardware and then carried on every repeated motor - a rocket correctly weighed at 1.2 kg flew at 1.4. A strap-on booster's nozzle exit was summed into the CORE stage's nozzle, crediting the core area it does not have while the boosters got no pressure thrust at all; the core now carries only its own motors. Batch could reset a mount set never to ignite, so an imported design with a dead motor flew it. And a RASAero import could subtract the wrong manufacturer's motor when two makers share a designation. Beyond those: a parachute with no drag coefficient typed now shows the 0.80 the kernel actually flies instead of a dash - that is 217 of the 473 catalogue canopies; a booster with two motors keeps its no-recovery warning; elliptical fins in the 3D view and the whole-rocket exports are a true half ellipse rather than a sine hump 19 percent short; the 2D drawing keeps 200 px in a short window and the stats drawer gets out of its way; Quick Picks are offered only on the untouched starter rocket and only where they fit the mount; the parity aerodynamics model has one name everywhere, Classic Extended Barrowman; the 3D tab can no longer take the whole app down on a machine without WebGL; and the flight-data downloads refuse while the flight on screen is stale rather than writing a different rocket under its name.
